classic.label: With rounds
classic.description: Round by round: whoever is done waits for the others before the next round begins.

queue.label: With tables and a queue
queue.description: The schedule is fixed from the start. As soon as a table is free the next duel starts, so nobody waits for a whole round.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.description: Everybody plays everybody else exactly once. The schedule is fixed from the start. Good up to about 8 players.

champions_league.label: Champions League
champions_league.description: Everybody gets the same number of drawn opponents, but not all of them. The schedule is fixed from the start. Good for about 9 to 24 players.

swiss.label: Swiss system
swiss.description: Opponents are paired round by round by the standings, nobody meets anybody twice. Good for large fields.

setup.title: Settings

setup.roundsHint: An even number, at most the number of players minus 1. A duel is a single game without a draw.
setup.roundsRoundRobin: In a round robin the number follows from the number of players: everybody plays everybody once.
setup.prelaunch: Head start: draw rounds 1 and 2 in advance
setup.prelaunchHint: The first two rounds are fixed at the start, every later round is paired as soon as the one before the last is done. That keeps the tables busy.
setup.estimateNeedsPlayers: The duration can be estimated as soon as at least two players are registered.

setup.compare: Duration of the modes with {count} players

board.tableHelp: Sorted by wins. With equal wins the Buchholz sum (the wins of all opponents) decides, then the direct duel. Whoever left is grey and last, without a place.
board.tablesHelp: As soon as a table is free the next duel starts by itself. Players with the most open duels go first, at a tie whoever has waited longest.
board.scheduleHelp: The schedule is fixed from the start. Matchdays are only a display: a duel is played as soon as a table and both players are free.
board.scheduleHelpSwiss: In the Swiss system each round is paired as soon as the one before it is done. Later rounds only show up then.
board.resultFailed: The result could not be saved.
board.scheduleHelpRounds: All duels of a matchday are played side by side. The next matchday starts as soon as the last duel of the current one is done.

rematch.title: Rematch needed
rematch.text: {a} and {b} have already played each other, but there is no other opponent to make up the duel. Schedule it anyway?
rematch.failed: The duel could not be scheduled.

decider.title: Tie for first place
decider.text: {names} are level. A deciding duel settles first place.
decider.failed: The deciding duel could not be scheduled.

recompute.hint: Only pairings that have not started are drawn again from the current standings. Played and running duels stay.
recompute.noChange: Nothing would change at the current standings.
recompute.failed: The pairings could not be recalculated.

undecided.title: Decision pending
undecided.text: {names} left. The open duels wait until you have decided.

leave.title: {name} leaves
leave.intro: What should happen to the duels of {name}? In the standings {name} stays grey and without a place and still sees their own result.

optionA.label: A · As if they had never been there
optionA.description: All duels are struck, the played ones too. Whoever played or was to play them gets a replacement duel.

optionB.label: B · Played duels stay
optionB.description: Only the open duels are struck. Whoever still had an open duel against them gets a replacement duel.

leave.unavailable: This does not add up at the current standing: afterwards not everybody would have the same number of duels.
leave.laterHint: Their duels wait until you have decided.
leave.inDuel: The player is in a duel right now. Enter the result first.

disqualify.title: Disqualify {name}?
disqualify.description: {name} disappears from the standings completely and all duels are struck, as if they had never been there. This cannot be undone.
disqualify.failed: The disqualification could not be saved.

finish.title: Save and end the tournament?
finish.description: Everything that was played stays as the result. Duels that are still open will not be played.

help.title: How it works
help.point1: A duel is a single game. There is no draw and no time limit – only the winner is entered.
help.point2: All players end with the same number of duels. The tournament runs until everybody has played theirs.
help.point3: As soon as a table is free, the next possible duel starts. Whoever sits at a table shows under “Now”; whoever waits sees their number in the queue.
help.point4: If somebody drops out, the app rearranges the duels so everybody has the same number again.
help.rounds1: It is played matchday by matchday: all duels of a day run side by side, the next day starts when the last one is done.

queue.label: With tables and a queue
queue.description: The plan is fixed from the start. As soon as a table is free, the next duel starts – nobody waits for a whole round.

rounds.label: In rounds (matchdays)
rounds.description: Matchday by matchday: all duels of a day are played side by side, the next day starts when the last duel is done. No tables, no queue.

classic.label: Classic (rounds with points)
classic.description: Round by round with points: whoever is done waits for the others before the next round starts. The older kind of tournament, with scoring and byes.

1.label: A single duel (one game)
1.description: One game decides; only the winner is entered.

3.label: Best of 3
3.description: The first to win two games. You enter the result as 2:0 or 2:1; the minutes per duel are for the whole match.

swiss.label: Swiss
swiss.description: Players with similar records play each other; rematches are avoided.

round_robin.label: Round robin
round_robin.description: Every player plays every other player exactly once.

games.label: By games (3 · 2 · 1 · 0)
games.description: A win without dropping a game is worth 3 points, a win that dropped a game 2, a loss that won a game 1, any other loss 0. A 2:0 therefore ranks above a 2:1.

match.label: Classic (3 · 0)
match.description: A win is 3 points, a loss 0, whatever the games. (A draw is 1, only in older tournaments.)

none.label: No points
none.description: A player who sits out gets no points and no match played.

win.label: Like a 2:0 win
win.description: A player who sits out gets 3 points, as after a 2:0 win.
